verdict.rationale: Svelte's compiler-based reactivity ($state, $derived, $effect), scoped CSS, .svelte.js/.ts modules for shared reactive logic, and CLI tooling (sv check, sv add) are documented as supporting maintainable, performant growth, and one team reports migrating a 'huge/complex' React app to Svelte with better performance and dev productivity (svelte-comm-8). However, a hands-on report states that at scale 'rendering usually starts to cause problems before the interactivity... the solution is to go to a canvas' (svelte-comm-10), and other community notes cite lack of component ecosystem (svelte-comm-9) and weak testing docs (svelte-comm-11) as friction for larger codebases. Missing for 10: independent benchmarks on very large team codebases, first-party guidance on architecture patterns for scale, and resolution of the rendering-at-scale complaint.
